meta.name: host-observer
meta.description: Use this when fulfilling claude-mem observer jobs on Grok Bot: reply only skip_summary or one full observation XML, never prose.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 执行Grok Bot的记忆观察任务,只输出标准总结或完整观测结果。
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你需要让机器人按规范格式输出记忆观察结果。
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need a bot to report memory observations in a structured format.

howto.what: 模型只输出两种 XML:空闲/无工具结果时给 `<skip_summary>`,完成可检索单元时给 `<observation>`(含真实标题、4–10 条带路径事实与叙述)。不写散文、不混用、不以工具名作标题。
howto.when: 在 Grok Bot 执行 claude-mem observer 任务时触发,例如收到收件箱 job 或需返回聊天补全。无工具结果时给 skip_summary,完成可检索单元才给 observation。

say.text: 当前没有工具结果,请按规则只回 skip_summary。
say.note: 不会看到散文,只有跳过摘要。

say.text: 请按 host-observer 规则处理,不要输出散文。

howto.what_en: On claude-mem observer jobs, it emits only `<skip_summary>` when idle/no tool results, or one `<observation>` with real title, 4–10 facts incl. paths and narrative. No prose, no mixing, no tool-name title.
howto.when_en: Triggers on Grok Bot when you're fulfilling claude-mem observer jobs, e.g. an inbox job or returning a chat-completions body. No tool results → skip_summary; a finished searchable unit → one observation.

say_en.text: Please turn this fix into an observation per host-observer rules.
say_en.note: Outputs an observation XML with title and fact paths.

say_en.text: No tool results now; reply only skip_summary per the rules.
say_en.note: You get a skip summary, not prose.

say_en.text: Follow host-observer rules, never output prose.
say_en.note: Only skip_summary or one observation XML appears.
